name: Docsworth
description: Search and read your team's Docsworth pages, and send what you find to them as a draft PR, through docsworth serve on this machine.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
